theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_cm_cylinder_weight
theorems.statement: ∃ M₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ M₀ ∧ ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (y : Euclidean N) (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → ∃ h : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ h z ∧ h z ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ z, ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ → h z = 1) ∧ (∀ z, 2 * τ ≤ ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ → h z = 0) ∧ ∀ (z : Euclidean N) (S : Grassmannian N n), |fderiv ℝ h z (Grassmannian.project S (z - y))| ≤ M₀ / τ * ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ * ‖z - y‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
